response.original_title: So Cal Gas Bill Pay, Explained
response.overview: Updated November 22, 2026  1-888-510-9613 covers So Cal Gas bill pay for SoCalGas, by phone or at socalgas.com, and returns a confirmation number at the end.  For So Cal Gas bill pay, call 1-888-510-9613 with the account number and a source; a bank payment posts with no fee, a card adds a small charge. SoCalGas gas bill pay: have the account number ready, then call 1-888-510-9613 or use socalgas.com, and keep what posts. SoCalGas meter reading: 1-888-510-9613 takes the account number, states any fee before it runs, and confirms it on the spot. For anything a screen will not finish, 1-888-510-9613 takes it by phone from the account number.
